name: liamtra/tts-excel-deps
description: PhpSpreadsheet + its dependencies for the Travellers-Flight-Api-Platform front app (app/). Installs straight into vendor/excel so app/Config/Autoload.php and require 'vendor/excel/autoload.php' keep working unchanged. Was previously committed pre-built at vendor/excel on phpoffice/phpspreadsheet 1.21.0, which has known security advisories - upgraded here to a patched 1.x release.
